# Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection changes the sign of only one pion field, making the relative phase definition differ by an addition of π compared to refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three pion fields, making for a more natural comparison with the similar situation for monopoles.
- The profile function reaches zero at a radius s/2 from the centre of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), allowing the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be patched together continuously, with fields set to the vacuum outside each of the cores [3, 12, 7].
- Beyond the simple ansatz (3.7) for initial conditions, more sophisticated initial conditions were also employed based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
